subject: Outreach renewal: license allocation, split billing, and final quote
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Outreach renewal: license allocation & initial quote review

Team —

Attaching the Outreach renewal quote I received yesterday (see attachment). We’re up for renewal at the end of December and I want to lock scope/pricing early. Two items I need input on:

1) License allocation between SDRs and AEs. Marissa — can you confirm active seat counts and usage patterns (weekly active users, sequence volume)? Rishi — is there a preferred split for billing across Sales Ops vs Field GTM cost centers?

2) Split billing: our finance team prefers two invoices — one for SDR org (cost center 5012) and one for AEs (cost center 5020). Is Outreach able to issue split invoices or do we need to put in separate POs?

If Outreach will hold pricing until 12/31 with a signed PO, I’d like to push for a committed discount + onboarding credit. Please review the attached utilization report I pulled for Q3 so we have a baseline.

Next step: review by EOD Wednesday (11/18) so we can finalize numbers and share with procurement/legal.

—Markus
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Outreach-quote-Nov2026.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)
Attachment: Seat-utilization-report-Q3-2026.xlsx (XLSX, 92 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: license allocation & initial quote review

Markus —

Thanks for starting this. Quick notes after scanning Q3 usage:
- Active SDR seats (primary users): 34 (avg weekly active 29)
- AE seats: 22 (avg weekly active 18)
- Seat churn: ~2 seats/month across both teams
- Top sequences are used by SDRs; AEs primarily use cadences for follow-ups and personal outreach.

My recommendation: allocate 36 SDR seats and 20 AE seats in the renewal to give a small buffer for hiring. That maps cleanly to SDR budget (5012) and AE budget (5020).

Procurement ask: I need the vendor contact and a revised quote showing line items split by org so I can attach to the PO. Can Outreach do two bill-to lines on the same agreement? If not, we’ll create two POs referencing the same SOW.

I uploaded a short utilization snapshot to the Drive link Markus shared. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call with Jordan if helpful.

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Revenue Ops
Attachment: Seat-utilization-report-Q3-2026.xlsx (referenced)

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@outreach.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@outreach.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Outreach updated quote & split billing options

Hi Markus / Marissa / Monica —

Thanks for the details and the utilization report. I attached an updated quote that shows line items by seat group (SDR vs AE) and two options for billing:

A) Single invoice with internal cost allocation (simpler contract, single PO)
B) Two invoices split by bill-to (requires two billing accounts; we can support this but need separate PO numbers)

We can hold pricing until 12/31 with a signed SOW or DocuSign envelope. For annual commit we can offer the following: 12% on the base seat price at 58 total seats (36 SDR + 22 AE), plus a one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 toward Professional Services. If you commit to a 24-month term we can increase to 15% and raise the onboarding credit to $10,000.

I included a DocuSign link in the quote for the SOW and an option to generate two invoices if you provide two PO numbers and bill-to addresses.

Let me know if you want me to draft the SOW with explicit line items for each cost center — happy to do that.

Jordan
Enterprise Account Executive, Outreach
Attachment: Outreach-quote-Nov2026-updated.pdf (PDF, 328 KB)
Link: https://www.docusign.com/LongLink/Outreach-Deal-2026

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@outreach.io>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outreach updated quote & split billing options

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the updated quote. A couple of procurement checks before we proceed:
1) Legal needs SOC 2 Type II attestation and the most recent pen test summary. Can you attach those or point me to the compliance pack?
2) Data residency: our security team prefers US data residency for CRM/email activity. Please confirm where KV cache and logs are stored for outbound sequences.
3) Payment terms: Finance prefers Net 45 for software vendors. Is Net 45 possible on this renewal?

Assuming the compliance docs are in order, I can process two POs (5012 and 5020) as long as Outreach can issue two invoices referencing the same SOW. Please send the bill-to addresses and an updated DocuSign with fields for PO numbers.

—Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@outreach.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outreach updated quote & split billing options

Jordan —

Appreciate the flexibility. Two additional asks from my side before procurement signs off:
- Can Outreach include a one-time onboarding credit (we use this for config/workshops) — target $7,500 if possible.
- Can you confirm you’ll hold the 12% pricing through 12/31? If we can get 15% for a 24-month commitment, we’ll escalate for approval.
- Regarding split billing: please confirm whether Outreach will accept two PO numbers on a single SOW or if you require separate SOWs. If separate SOWs are required, please call that out in the DocuSign to avoid delays.

If needed I can sign off on the SOW with a note that billing will be split and provide the POs once Monica issues them. We do prefer split invoices instead of internal chargebacks.

Let’s aim to finalize terms by 11/24 so legal has time to review before year-end.

—Markus

Markus / Monica / Marissa —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick confirmations:
- Compliance pack (SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary) attached in this reply; also sent to your security contact via secure link.
- Data residency: primary customer metadata and campaign logs reside in our US region. KV cache used for runtime is transient and stored on US-backed infrastructure. I will confirm the exact hosting region for audit purposes.
- Payment terms: Net 45 is acceptable for this account.

On commercials: we can do a 12% discount for a 12-month term and hold pricing through 12/31 with a signed DocuSign envelope. For a 24-month commit we can provide 15%. We will include a $7,500 onboarding credit as requested.

Split billing: Outreach can issue two invoices referencing the same SOW if you provide two PO numbers and distinct bill-to addresses. We don’t need separate SOWs. Please provide the PO numbers and the preferred bill-to names/addresses and we’ll update the DocuSign envelope.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Monica issues two POs (5012 / 5020) with billing details.
2) Marissa confirms final seat counts (36 SDR / 22 AE).
3) Jordan sends updated DocuSign with 12% discount and $7,500 onboarding credit (or 15%/10k for 24-month).

If you’re ready I can generate the DocuSign today and we can have Procurement sign by early next week.

Thanks —
Jordan
